round_intro_zh:
小组赛第二轮全面打响。首轮已让本轮的六分战和出线生死战全部摆上台面：A 组墨西哥 6 分领跑已锁定晋级，韩国 + 捷克 + 南非争次席；B 组加拿大 + 瑞士 4 分领跑，6/24 末轮头名直接对话；C 组巴西首轮闷平摩洛哥，本轮对弱旅海地不能再失分；D 组美国 vs 澳大利亚两支首轮全胜队伍正面碰撞；E 组德国 7-1 库拉索状态恐怖，本轮对非洲杯冠军科特迪瓦才是真正考验；F 组瑞典 5-1 突尼斯爆大冷，荷兰首战闷平日本已无退路；G/H 组四队齐平的乱局进入第二轮，最容易爆冷；J 组阿根廷 + 奥地利两支首轮全胜队伍直接对话，卫冕冠军压力拉满。

本周 16 场必看里，最不能错过的有 5 场：Argentina vs Austria（J 组头名之争，卫冕首战）、Germany vs Ivory Coast（德国真正考验）、England vs Ghana（英格兰非洲劲旅考验）、USA vs Australia（东道主首秀）、Switzerland vs Canada（B 组末轮头名之战）。
round_intro_en:
Matchday 2 is here and the stakes are suddenly real. Eight teams opened with wins and the second-leg matchups are now six-pointers: USA vs Australia in Group D, Argentina vs Austria in Group J, plus Germany vs Ivory Coast and England vs Ghana — all four heavyweights face mid-tier opposition this round. Sweden's shock 5-1 over Tunisia puts pressure on the Netherlands, while Spain's 0-0 draw with Cape Verde means La Roja cannot afford another slip. The Group B climax lands on Wed 6/24: Canada vs Switzerland will decide the top seed.

Of the 16 must-watch games this week, five you really can't miss: Argentina–Austria (Mon 12 PM CT, champions' first defense), Germany–Ivory Coast (Sat 3 PM CT, Germany's real test), England–Ghana (Tue 3 PM CT, Three Lions' African acid test), USA–Australia (Fri 2 PM CT, co-hosts' debut), and Switzerland–Canada (Wed 2 PM CT, Group B's top-spot showdown).
